title: Electrical Design Engineer
desc:
We are looking for talents to build their career as an
Electrical Design Engineer
for our
Head Office
in
Besiktas, Istanbul.
In ENKA family, you can;
Have a chance to work for the largest engineering and construction company of Turkey,
Be a part of a global company of over 17.000 employees,
Build your career in a company with experience over 65+ years of experience,
Gain experience in corporate culture with a global management approach,
Have access to future opportunities for working in other countries over 5 continents where we are currently operating after the successful completion of this assignment.
QUALIFICATIONS
B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in
Electrical
Engineering,
Min. 5 years of experience in a relevant role,
Good command of written and spoken English,
Advanced user of MS Office applications,
Strong communication skills and ability to work as a team player,
Analytical mindset; organized, adaptable, proactive, and detail-oriented,
Willing to travel and no restriction to work abroad or relocate for project assignments.
JOB DESCRIPTION
The Electrical Design Engineer is responsible for the technical production and detailed engineering of power systems within the Data Center design team. Candidates are expected to be responsible for executing the MV, LV, ELV design, performing core electrical calculations, and ensuring the 3D BIM model (LOD 300) reflects the engineering intent. This role requires a professional who can translate a conceptual Single Line Diagram (SLD) into a fully coordinated, constructible, and redundant electrical system that meets mission-critical uptime standards.
Develop and refine Protection & Metering SLDs for MV/LV systems, Load Lists, Cable Schedules, and Panel Schedules.
Execute core electrical calculations for: Cable Sizing - Voltage drop and derating calculations based on tray fill and ambient conditions. Protection - Arc Flash hazard assessments and breaker setting schedules. Systems - Earthing, Lightning Protection, and specialized Lighting calculations using Dialux.
Lead the electrical 3D modeling (LOD 300) effort in Revit, ensuring that cable containment, switchgear footprints, and clearance zones are clash-free and coordinated with Mechanical and Structural disciplines.
Prepare detailed Electrical Equipment Datasheets and Material Requisitions (MRs) for MV, LV and ELV systems.
Support the Lead Engineer in evaluating vendor bids to ensure technical compliance with project specifications.
Perform detailed reviews of vendor drawings, shop drawings, and submittals, ensuring they integrate seamlessly into the overall plant design.
Generate and manage accurate Bills of Quantities (BOQ) for procurement and construction estimating.
Ensure all assigned deliverables are submitted according to the Master Document Register (MDR) schedule.
Ensure all designs strictly follow IEC/IEEE standards, as well as NFPA 70 (NEC) and project-specific safety guidelines.
Provide engineering assistance during the construction and commissioning phases, resolving field queries.
